reviews.author: Archer
reviews.text: Joshua was great to deal with. I have a European car with AWD that requires a flatbed. Joshua arrived onsite and started quickly. Didn’t take more than 15 minutes to get my car loaded on the bed. He was nice and easy to talk to. I would definitely recommend to anyone needing a tow of their vehicle.

reviews.author: Micky Hale
reviews.text: Just used Elite to haul a classic car I just purchased and they were very punctual and the driver was super cautious with getting my car to me safely. Will definitely call them again for my needs.

reviews.author: Ronald Eckles Jr.
reviews.text: First off I want to thank Joshua and Elite Towing and Recovery for all the help today! Insurance contacted Joshua for towing services after my vehicle was totaled. Joshua reached to me to let me know he would be helping me out today. He communicated what jobs he had to complete before heading to grab my vehicle and I appreciate that. He seemed very genuine and he notified me when the job was completed. I’m very grateful for all the help. Thank you, Elite Towing and Recovery!

reviews.author: Paul R. Roncone
reviews.text: Joshua at Elite Towing & Recovery was absolutely amazing. He arrived quickly, was extremely knowledgeable, and kept me informed throughout the entire process. He made a stressful situation so much easier with his professionalism and great attitude. You can tell he genuinely cares about helping people and doing the job right. I truly appreciate the excellent service and would highly recommend Joshua and Elite Towing & Recovery to anyone needing roadside assistance or towing services.

reviews.author: Chris Lazor
reviews.text: I had a tire fail on my classic truck and unfortunately don't have a spare so I needed to get it towed to my house. Joshua arrived and was extremely nice, he had me and my classic truck back to my house in no time at all. This is the second time Elite has helped me with an issue and both times they have been professional and very helpful. When calling the office they are polite and very understanding. I definitely recommend them for any towing or roadside needs. Thank you!

reviews.author: Theresa Kendig
reviews.text: Tristin was prompt and friendly. My car only needed a jump for the battery, but he very knowledgeable as he informed me about my battery and alternator And how they work together. He got my car started and I made it home safely. Getting a new battery today. Thanks again Tristin.

reviews.author: Jessica Bern
reviews.text: Joshua with Elite Towing was amazing. He helped with my 20+ year old son get his stranded car towed on a Sunday! He was prompt and made the situation so much better, he called and let me Know he took care of my son. I was out of town so he made it so much easier and less stressful on my end! I highly recommend. Elite towing and Joshua!!

reviews.author: Charlie Roberts
reviews.text: Tow man Joshua was such a friendly and helpful individual. He even open the hood of the car to see if he could resolve the issue of not starting, towed the car to my mechanic without issue and wants me to notify him what the issue was with not starting. Enjoyed talking with him and the tow company has a real gem. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Brenda Mcclary
reviews.text: Joshua was very professional. His ETA was on point. He knew exactly what he was doing and was able to assist us as quickly as possible. His mannerism was much appreciated. His service is what we need more of in this world right now. Thank you Josh. Job well done.

reviews.author: Mara Starnes
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company- I recently used them for a towing and a car lockout service. Joshua is very kind and both times he communicated his ETA, arrived promptly and worked quickly.

reviews.author: Alicia
reviews.text: Joshua came and helped get my car to the mechanic which is where I was trying to take anyway it but my car wasn’t having it. He was absolutely wonderful, punctual, and efficient. I would definitely recommend and use again if necessary! I have roadside through my insurance so I’m just not sure about pricing/cost.

reviews.author: nayra suarez (mangopapayachocolate)
reviews.text: Joshua was a phenomenal professional. He spent a long time trying to figure out how to tow a dead super heavy truck and didn’t give up. Besides he was kind, nice and patient. I find him a great expert.

reviews.author: Nathan Doctry
reviews.text: Joshua of Elite Towing and Recovery was prompt, cool and professional. He knows what he's doing with a special understanding of Electric Vehicles. Fair pricing and I would highly recommend this outfit! N.Doctry, MD

reviews.author: Shopping Tripp
reviews.text: Excellent response times. Josh was able to come out and change my tire after I had a bolt stuck in it. He was super friendly and gave me some excellent tips and questions to ask when I have the tire replaced. I truly appreciated his promptness and attention to detail.

reviews.author: Jamiese Arnold
reviews.text: My experience with Elite Towing was amazing. Joshua was excellent with communication, very trusting, and overall professionalism. Joshua understood all of my pick up instructions. The fact that when he delivered my vehicle to its destination, he made sure that everything was locked and secured.

reviews.author: Don Moore
reviews.text: Helped tow me to safety through my company car's Element Fleet service and was very happy with Joshua and his helpfulness, friendliness and professionalism as we had to deal with our minor car emergency. Would gladly recommend these guys to everyone!

reviews.author: Katie Bailes-Bailey
reviews.text: Joshua was so kind, informative & patient! He even took my call a few minutes after for a question I had. I would definitely call Elite again, especially if I knew Joshua was coming!! Thank you for coming to help me & my son!

reviews.author: Raymond Stevens
reviews.text: I just completed a tow with Joshua, the man is phenomenal. He was courteous, polite, troubleshoot things when needed ….was very respectful of my property. He drove the speed limit and took excellent care of my vehicle. I could not have been happier given the circumstances that I don’t have a vehicle to drive.

reviews.author: Jackie Bacon
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Elite Towing! The driver, Joshua was such a kind and respectful man, very professional and patient. He took his time carefully unloading a low ground car, making sure everything was done safely and without a scratch. You could tell he really cared about doing the job right. I truly appreciate the extra attention to detail and would definitely recommend Elite Towing to anyone needing reliable and thoughtful service.

reviews.author: Johnnie Fox
reviews.text: Joshua was very cordial. He delivered my vehicle to the dealership in a prompt and professional manner. I would contact Elite towing again without hesitation!

reviews.author: Lauren Chave
reviews.text: My tire popped driving home and Charlie saved me!! Super quick response time and extremely efficient and professional once on site. Put my spare on for me in less than 10 minutes. I was only on the side of the highway for less than a hour once roadside assistance thru my insurance was contacted. Communication via text was amazing before and after arriving on scene. Got home (3 hour drive later) safe and sound! Really appreciate everything, 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Deanna Caughman
reviews.text: Joshua came and jumped my battery. He was prompt with service and communicated from the very beginning. He even tested my alternator for me just to check out what he could. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Triston Major
reviews.text: Elite Towing is the way to go. I fell asleep at the wheel and hit a guard rail. Both tires popped, wheels cracked on left side and bumper on the left side was in atrocious condition. When the driver showed up he changed my back tire to a donut spare on the side of the road as to not further damage the back wheel and got us going to a shop. They said they weren’t able to help and Mr. Cesar happily towed us to a shop that would be able to help me further. After putting the car down he personally looked at it himself to assess some of the damage and fixed my horn for me. Not only that but he gives some great advice and if you get the chance, I would 100% recommend them the next time anybody needs a tow in the area!

reviews.author: Carmella Pritchett
reviews.text: I got stuck in mud and needed assistance getting out. Joshua reached out for details and arrived more quickly than estimated. He was very skilled at getting me out of the mud and back on concrete so I could drive my car. He was polite and gave clear directions on how to handle my car in order to get unstuck. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Greg Smith
reviews.text: Joshua showed up for a Polestar roadside assistance call. Awesome person and awesome job. Knowlegable, had modern equipment and felt comfortable letting him handle my 3 week old retirement car! Awesome driver for an awesome company! Many thanks!

reviews.author: Gina Merrell
reviews.text: Had to be picked up due to a flat tire and couldn't have asked for a better tow company. Joshua communicated, was prompt, super helpful and polite. He did a great job and made a bad day a little better.

reviews.author: Tammy Freeman
reviews.text: This recent bad weather we've had left me stranded unable to get out to go anywhere. After 3 days I took a chance and called my insurance company. Elite Towing is who they sent. Josh was the greatest. Not only did he get my car out from the slick ice but he made me comfortable with it being on the side of the road. He even made sure that I was comfortable get out the next morning and made sure I knew how to park securely when I got back home after work. I highly recommend Elite Towing. Thanks again guys.

reviews.author: Chanelle Santana
reviews.text: Josh from Elite Towing reached out and to me once he got the request and stayed in contact with me through out the whole process. He was very knowledgable and helpful. Hopefully you never have to get towed but if you do I recommend Elite Towing .

reviews.author: Angela Duckett
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. The tow truck arrived quickly and the drivers were very precessional. Pricing was very reasonable especially for a weekend.

reviews.author: Jeremy Collins
reviews.text: Service was prompt and Josh was great to work with. Everything went very smooth which is always great in stressful situations. If you need a tow, definitely call Elite.

reviews.author: Sharon Farrington
reviews.text: Josh was the tow driver, I cannot express enough how he performed his job with such kindness and dedication to me, but also to the Elite Towing Company. He did not rush the job! Josh went as far as trying to see if he could help me instead of towing. I did not have to wait on him to answer the call he was very prompt I am thrilled I called Elite today to help me. Thank You very much

reviews.author: Sandra Kudela
reviews.text: My 2024 Camaro SS with stuck in the ice in my son's driveway. I made multiple attempts to free it without success. I called my State farm agent who referred me to elite towing and recovery. They sent Joshua out and I could not be more thrilled and excited and happy with the service he gave me and my son. I appreciate his efforts so much and I am home safe and sound without any damage to my vehicle. Please give Joshua my thanks again.

reviews.author: Matt corsello
reviews.text: Josh was a great tow truck driver!! He is very knowledgeable and was quick with service. I would definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Kaylen.Arianna
reviews.text: nate was amazing this is the second time that my car has been towed and he did it with ease and updated me every step of the way! 100% will tow again with this company as long as he is still working there!

reviews.author: Jessica M.
reviews.text: I wish I could rate this as more than 5 star. This company is extremely great! I had an issue with my car earlier tonight and they did not hesitate to come help, even tow my car to my house, which is not in Iredell County. Ray was just awesome, very friendly, kind and pleasant to work with. I will definitely be keeping their number in my favorites! Thank you so much Elite Towing & Recovery!

reviews.author: Walter Williamson
reviews.text: We were stranded in our motorhome 60 miles west of Casper, WY at 4 PM. Russell and Cindy came to our rescue and towed us back to Casper. According to the repair tech they did an excellent job. They were all so nice and accommodating.

reviews.author: Jeff Keefe
reviews.text: I was stranded with my motorcycle and called one place it was going to be at least 1.5 hours so I called elite and they said 30 min. When driver arrived in less then the 30 minutes helped me push my bike backwards and put on the coolest motorcycle tow vehicle I’ve ever seen. Rich the operator took his time to ensure my bike was secured and dropped off at the repair shop for half the cost of the 1st place I called . Rich was very professional and we had an awesome conversation while he was loading up my bike . Thankyou Elite towing

reviews.author: Megan Garrison
reviews.text: My insurance roadside assistance dispatched them to me this morning as I was stranded on the side of I-77 during heavy rush hour traffic. Charlie (I think that was his name) arrived in less than a half an hour and made sure I was safe and taken care of. Thank you for taking care of me quickly! Would definitely recommend y’all and will keep you in mind if I ever need your services again.

reviews.author: Jacob Larson
reviews.text: Joshua at Elite Towing was a huge help and very considerate as well as respectful of my property! Would definitely recommend, fair pricing!

reviews.author: EmmaLee Haga
reviews.text: Joshua & the owner were phenomenal. Such quick service. Joshua was there within 20 minutes after I spoke to the owner/dispatcher and jumped my car. We thought we needed a tow but he looked at the battery and gave us knowledge on what to do next. Not only did he save me money and time but he was so helpful, kind and supportive in the process. I would highly recommend Joshua & Elite Towing to everyone.

reviews.author: emilio rodriguez
reviews.text: The tow truck driver Josh was very care full and extremely professional putting my car on the flatbed I was well pleased with his knowledge performance and professional service and skill…..

reviews.author: Champayne Eubanks
reviews.text: I highly recommend Elite Towing & Recovery. My family got the pleasure of having Nate as our tow truck driver. Nate was our angel sent from heaven. He made our car catastrophe turn completely around. He sent pictures after he dropped of our at the tire shop to ensure it was there and in a safe place. Thank you so much again Nate.

reviews.author: MacKenzie Wine
reviews.text: Cesar was a lifesaver today!! He came to help swiftly and was keeping me updated on his arrival time. He was very detailed in his inspection of my car and was able to fix the issue himself after safely towing me and my dog to a safe location away from the shoulder of the highway. I am so satisfied with his services! He was friendly and kept the situation very calm. So happy to have him come to my rescue!

reviews.author: Zachary Sawyer
reviews.text: Excellent towing service. Great price and smooth process. Joshua showed up and got everything taken care of quickly and easily. Excellent communication and very personable team. I will use this company for any future towing needs and recommend them to friends and family!

reviews.author: Marcy Rich
reviews.text: Joshua had me back in my locked vehicle in less than a minute. Fast, reliable and professional service. Thank you again, Joshua!!!

reviews.author: Coty
reviews.text: Clear communication, extremely fast service, friendly, and professional. All at a very fair price. They will be my first and only call in the future.

reviews.author: Mark Bodnar
reviews.text: Super grateful for the fast, clean and safe pickup of my yukon! Placed it in the driveway as the professional he is! Thank you Joshua!

reviews.author: Michael Reitzen
reviews.text: Had two blown tires and needed a tow, Joshua was prompt and very professional with the whole process. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Brian Quick
reviews.text: Joshua was our tow driver and he was amazing! I literally called at 2pm to get a tow for my vehicle and they were there within 15 minutes. Joshua was very respectful, thorough and made sure to take care of our car. Great towing service!

reviews.author: beyunka thomas
reviews.text: This company is AWESOME!!!! Very friendly, efficient and knowledgeable about his job. Nate made me feel good about making sure my car would be delivered safely . If you are ever in distress and need a GREAT Tow company Elite Towing and Recovery is the one to call.

reviews.author: Brianna Amitrano
reviews.text: I walked out to a flat tire this morning and Progressive put me in touch with Elite Towing and Recovery. I had the pleasure of meeting Joshua who was so kind and helpful. He truly made a stressful situation enjoyable. Thanks to him I made it safely to the tire shop so I can drive my son back to App State as planned today. Thank you for responding so quickly, and for the amazing experience!

reviews.author: Stephen Parks
reviews.text: Joshua from Elite Towing came out, quickly assessed the situation and got the job done. He was very helpful and professional.

reviews.author: Todd Carswell
reviews.text: Our van broke down on I40 while on a trip to the NC mountains and we found Elite Towing through our insurance provider. The alternator died and we were stranded on the busy highway! Thankfully, Elite Towing also performs automotive repairs and they do work on the weekends! Throughout this episode, we interacted with Luis (owner), Cesar (manager), and Katie (Business Manager) and we could not have been happier with the friendly folks and professional service. Thanks so much, everyone!

reviews.author: Gavin Magaha
reviews.text: Josh was overly accommodating and a pleasure to work with. Very professional and extremely friendly which was greatly appreciated in that stressful moment.

reviews.author: Christy Love
reviews.text: Josh did a great job. He is wonderful. Thank you so much for the service. I will recommend you guys to my friends.

reviews.author: Tania Wilson
reviews.text: Joshua showed up and helped my daughter with her car. He was extremely nice and explained to her that her tire wasn’t locked up but was moving in reverse. He took my daughter and her car to the auto place. Very professional and wonderful service!!

reviews.author: kplus handyman
reviews.text: Thank you nate at elite towing for showing up promptly and to taking care of our work van. If we ever have a problem again. We know who to call!! Best service in the Pine.

reviews.author: Celina Lever
reviews.text: Joshua was very prompt, efficient, professional, and friendly, when I needed my battery jumped. He even gave me some tips on car maintenence, and recommendations for service providers. Highly recommend him and Elite Towing.

reviews.author: LaNaria James
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Elite Towing & Recovery after my car accident. Rich was very nice, friendly, and incredibly helpful during a stressful time. He showed real empathy and made sure I felt taken care of throughout the process. I really appreciate the professionalism and kindness. Highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Kaylee Griswold
reviews.text: Super helpful, punctual, took great care of getting my vehicle to me & provided updates along the way.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: Dead battery, and first service provider my insurance company contacted was a no-show. Elite showed up fast. Joshua was a knowledgeable and friendly technician who got me on the road in time to beat holiday traffic. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Naiomi Washington
reviews.text: Joshua was one of the best technicians for a problem with my car for towing. It was a difficult Toe due to electronic parking brake issues and he was able to tow it with ease and the most pleasant to deal with. great service!!!!

reviews.author: Giannie Small
reviews.text: I had an awesome experience with Nate he kept me informed of his location and his ETA. Nate is a very knowledgeable person he explained the process and kept me calm during the process. Nate is genuinely a great person….ELITE you have yourself a wonderful person on your hands.

reviews.author: Mark Patterson
reviews.text: Excellent service ! Nate was so awesome and helped my wife with a flat tire tow when I was out of town. They got there so fast and were so professional.

reviews.author: Heather Young
reviews.text: Elite Towing and Recovery is THE BEST! I ran out of gas with my 4 kids in the car and Nate came to our rescue in under 25 minutes. He filled us up, offered to follow us to the gas station to ensure we made it safely AND had a follow up phone call to make sure the car was working safely as we kept heading to our vacation. So grateful for his fast work and the kindness he showed to us. 100% recommend!

reviews.author: William Privette
reviews.text: Very prompt and professional service. The gentleman knew what he was talking about answered all my questions that I had was very kind and courteous.

reviews.author: Chris Willcox
reviews.text: Exceptional customer service and never before have I had a tow truck company concerned about my safety. They showed me how to override the neutral safety switch then called me back the next day to explain how to reengage it. I will “tow” everyone about my amazing experience with this company. Joshua is amazing!!!!

reviews.author: Aprl Maffetone
reviews.text: The driver Joshua Harris was friendly, prompt and respectful, it was a pleasure doing business with Elite. Thank you!

reviews.author: Luke Yankoe
reviews.text: Katie and her driver Joshua were great. On time. Quick service. Great communication. Would recommend to anyone looking for a tow/recovery company.

reviews.author: N Morris
reviews.text: Charlie and Josh were great! I had my car towed 3 times (between mechanic shops) and received excellent service from these guys. One time, excellent communication and very professional and cool. Great representatives of Elite Towing!

reviews.author: Vanessa Tyler
reviews.text: I needed a lockout service today and Joshua answered the call. He was VERY helpful and SUPER friendly. The service was quick and very hassle free. If I could give more stars I would! Definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Jacki Bagwell
reviews.text: They were so very helpful after my accident, especially with helping me navigate the insurance process. They also offered to help with replacing the custom items on my jeep and to get the original parts back on. I can’t recommend them high enough. They need 10 stars!

reviews.author: E. M. McNear
reviews.text: Joshua was very professional and timely! His communication with respect to updates was very appreciated. I will use this company moving forward and encourage others to do the same.

reviews.author: Suzanne Dudko
reviews.text: Excellent customer service!! Tristan went above and beyond to assist me with towing my vehicle. His expertise, patience, and explanation exceeded my expectations. I will definitely use this company in the future and will definitely recommend anyone in need as well. Thank you again!! Very happy and satisfied customer.

reviews.author: Carly
reviews.text: Had a great experience having my car towed by Joshua at Elite Towing. He was quick and made sure the service was done right.

reviews.author: Devin Clinton
reviews.text: Joshua was punctual and provided fast service. Very friendly and made sure I was all set before driving off. What an inconvenience to get a flat tire on the highway! I'm happy he was able to come save the day

reviews.author: emily kiral
reviews.text: My insurance recommended Elite Towing. Cesar came as soon as he got the call. He send me pictures of the car once it was dropped off at the shop. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Andrea Easterly
reviews.text: After incurring a flat tire driving through NC yesterday, my State Farm roadside assistance dispatched Elite Towing to put on the spare. Joshua (with Elite) called a few minutes later to provide his eta (less than 15 min). Once he arrived, Joshua was very friendly, patient, thorough, and informed. Also funny. Lol. As a woman traveling alone, getting a flat tire on a major highway, on Easter Sunday no less, ranks pretty high up on my list of what I wouldn't consider fun, but Joshua really helped put me at ease. He gave me his honest assessment of the viability of my tire and highlighted potential safety concerns were I to continue to drive back to Georgia on the spare tire. In all, Joshua was GREAT and VERY professional! And as a representative of Elite Towing, he nailed it!! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Dwayne Campbell
reviews.text: I was on the side of a major highway, between two exits with a car that wouldn't drive due to an issue with my battery. It was late with the sun setting and starting to rain. I waited for a while, nervous the whole time. I've watched enough shows, news reports, and videos about roadside accidents happening in an instance to be concerned. When I call to get an correct ETA, I let the dispatcher know of my concerns, and he did his best to expedite the situation. When the tow truck arrived, I met a very considerate and professional driver in Joshua. He stood out there with me and listened and offer sound advice and support. He not only got my car off the side of the road, he also got me to somewhere safe. And he stayed and try to resolve my issue himself, and show true care about me problem. He made me feel safe, and though I have to still deal with the issue hampering my car, I am confident from my encounter with Joshua that all will be well. This is one of those you had to be there moment to fully appreciate why I'm taking my time to write this review. We know that first responders are considered heroes for doing there job and then some. And rightly so. Tonight, I met my hero in Joshua. I believe he did his job to the upmost, and he went beyond with his kindness and sympathy. If that is not a hero, I would like someone to please define what one is. And to all tow truck drivers out there, I want to thank you all for what you do. Most would never think that you guys have a dangerous job, but get stuck on the side of a busy highway on a raining night, with trucks and cars shooting by, and here comes a tow truck and he is out there trying to get you and yours to safety, and you will understand and appreciate their efforts just as much as i did this evening. He gave me his card for Elite Towing. Hopefully, I won't need them again, but if I am in need of roadside assistance, I'm calling them up and asking if Joshua on shift.

reviews.author: Matt Sadinsky
reviews.text: New Subaru had flat tire & without a spare tire arranged towing within an hour - Josh is a pro, courteous, on time & towed car in for tire repair. All good!

reviews.author: Tom Kufeld
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company. Water pump went out on my truck Easter Sunday in the parking lot and Joshua arrived on the seen within an hour and immediately went to work. He assured me the vehicle was in good hands and he would take care of it as if it was his own! Great customer service!

reviews.author: Jason St. Aubin
reviews.text: My starter busted and I was stranded after 5pm without many options. Elite Towing and their team came to the rescue! The tow was reasonable, the driver was kind, the staff was great, and they were able to tow my car and have the repairs completed in less than 24 hours. The price was very fair and the owner Luis is a stand up guy. If you find yourself needing help, Elite is a great choice!

reviews.author: Spiritual MJ
reviews.text: Joshua I used my insurance for roadside assistance and Joshua was phenomenal! got my car towed and was very friendly had a good conversation and laugh and gave quality work! 100% recommend for any towing needs. i can now breathe cause imma get my car fixed soon! go to them don’t think twice about it

reviews.author: Joey Fleming
reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Nate who expertly rescued my vehicle when nobody else could. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ariel Thomas
reviews.text: I had an incredible experience with Elite Towing & Recovery I was stranded over an hour away, and despite the distance, they didn’t hesitate to come to my rescue. They were quick, professional, and went above and beyond to make sure I was safe and taken care of. The driver was friendly and made a stressful situation feel so much easier. I really appreciate the effort and dedication they showed in going out of their way to help me out. Highly recommend Elite towing and recovery to anyone in need of a reliable, dependable towing service! Thank you for truly going the extra mile.

reviews.author: Rachel Lomax
reviews.text: Joshua was so pleasant and professional. He informed me of what might be going on with my vehicle and he was right. He also got to my vehicle in less than a hour. It was great doing business with him

reviews.author: Aaron Hallman
reviews.text: Joshua came on time to pick up my 2010 Acura TL and delivered it to the auto shop without any incidents. He was kind and courteous and even gave me some sound advice on my car that was greatly appreciated. I would definitely use Elite towing again if he is picking up my car.

reviews.author: Master Tech
reviews.text: Joshua is an awesome guy. Very relatable and good hearted person. Will definitely recommend his service.

reviews.author: Benjamin Gaspar
reviews.text: Nate towed my car to the dealership for repairs. He was very nice and professional. Another company came out before him and wouldnt tow it but Nate took care of it in less than half an hour. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Deborah Potts
reviews.text: After being stood up by AAA 2 days in a row, I remembered I had roadside assistance with my insurance. Cesar with Elite Towing arrived within an hour and jump started my vehicle. He was super nice and recommended I purchase a new battery. I highly recommend their service and cancel your AAA.

reviews.author: Deidre Keller
reviews.text: My driver was Cesar and he was really nice and helpful! All he had to do was pick up my vehicle and take it where it needed to go, but he took the time to put air in my tires and kept updated! Best tow service I've had so far!

reviews.author: Brelyn Mcdonald
reviews.text: Elite was able to pickup my car at the time I requested and was very pleasant over the phone and in person. Joshua got me and my car to the dealer in a short amount of time.

reviews.author: Thomas Goodwin
reviews.text: Joshua was professional and helpful. We towed my van to Advanced Transmission safely. My experience was great!

reviews.author: Wilbert Walker
reviews.text: Elite Towing & Recovery Driver Nate Helped Me Out Tremendously. Showed Up In Great Timing When I Was Stranded & Transported My Vehicle To It's Destination Without Any Issues. Will Definitely Use Theirs Services Again

reviews.author: Matthew Olson
reviews.text: Joshua communicated when he would arrive, was on time, and did an excellent job. He was polite and professional.

reviews.author: brad solomon
reviews.text: I made a miscalculation in my fuel supply and ran out of gas on the way home from a business trip. I reached out to Elite Towing and they were quick to respond! Nate was there in no time at all and had us on the way. I recommend Elite Towing and Nate to everyone! A+++ Service!

reviews.author: Stephanie M R
reviews.text: Cesar came to the rescue upon knowing I had a flat. He was so nice and professional about the whole thing. He took his time to assess the problem. He had me back on the road in no time! I highly recommend calling elite towing and recovery for all of your roadside needs! Thanks so much, Cesar!

reviews.author: Shari Harris
reviews.text: I had a blow out on the side of the road and Cesar came to pick me up. He made sure I was safe and got me where I needed to go. He was kind and provided me comfort in a hard time. He also provided me with a lot of good information about my car! I highly recommend using this company.

reviews.author: Toni Mumford
reviews.text: Josh did an amazing job with getting our tire changed but also being able to get a stripped Lug Nut off as well. Thank you so much

reviews.author: Alisha Bland
reviews.text: Joshua was our driver, he was very nice and funny too. He was stuck in traffic and relayed that information to us, and actually got there faster than expected.

reviews.author: Tracy mcleod
reviews.text: My driver Nate was a sweetheart. He was very helpful and polite. And he got to me within a hour. Would truly recommend asking for Nate

reviews.author: Santa Nieves
reviews.text: Amazing company. Woke up to a flat tire, while home alone with my children. Mr. Nate kept me informed of his ETA, and reassured me everything would be just fine. Fast, reliable, and amazing company! Would love to do business again!

reviews.author: Alex Cavallo
reviews.text: Cesar was prompt and helpful, got the vehicle started without a tow, and provided good advice on where to get the battery replaced. I was treated fairly and honestly. Great experience. Highly recommend Elite.

reviews.author: Karyl Floyd
reviews.text: Elite Towing and Recovery was so fast on a last minute car start need for me. Needed it to be pretty quick and they came through on that. Great service.

reviews.author: Joe Beane
reviews.text: Owners overheard my dilemma with my truck and asked if they could help. They had a tow truck to my location in 10 minutes and he went straight to work. They were great and the driver was as well. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Kirk Kranson
reviews.text: Joshua was great to work with. He made the whole process go smoothly. Will definitely use again if needed

reviews.author: Christina Laghrida
reviews.text: I was pleased with the prompt arrival and delivery of my car! Cesar was easy to work with, very helpful and offered some great advice. I would recommend this one company to anyone needing service!

reviews.author: Gwendolyn Arnold
reviews.text: Cesar was fantastic! He was very helpful, personable and was very careful with my vehicle. I appreciate his professionalism and attention to detail. I highly recommend Elite Towing!

reviews.author: Ariel Mosley
reviews.text: Once I was matched, they arrived within 12 minutes. He changed my tire, and they kept me updated the entire time. I was really grateful for the assistance and would go to them again.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.text: Fast, professional, and friendly. I locked myself out of my vehicle and they arrived much quicker than the estimated time and had me back in my vehicle in moments. I appreciated the dowth to earth attitude and reassurance that this happens all the time.

reviews.author: Thomas Musantry
reviews.text: Elite towing came to my house and he was prompt. He took care of starting my care and told me I needed a new battery. With this information I went to Subaru today and they replaced the battery I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Keith Parson
reviews.text: Picked up my car in a very timely manner on a Sunday evening. Josh communicated throughout the process, which i appreciated. Will use again for sure!

reviews.author: Andrea Nemechek
reviews.text: Joshua went above and beyond to help us! He is definitely an asset to the company! An amazing guy! 5 stars all the way!!!

reviews.author: Natalie Solomon
reviews.text: Wonderful service. Gave us notifications of where and when he would arrive. He promptly got us into our car and we were on our way. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Mandy Mills
reviews.text: Joshua was amazing! Kept me updated every step of the way! Above and beyond expectations! Will definitely use again!

reviews.author: Victoria Gulickson
reviews.text: Joshua was on time, attentive, professional, personable and an all around great representation for his company. I would rely on him and his company every time!

reviews.author: Roger Orozco
reviews.text: Nate was outstanding, arrived to tow my son’s car in an expedited manner and extremely courteous professional. I definitely recommend Elite Towing& Recovery to any who has car trouble in the future.

reviews.author: adam henderson
reviews.text: My wife got a flat tire in downtown mooresville while I was at a father daughter dance. Rae came out and installed the spare for her and got her back on the road. All the guys there are very helpful and professional. I would recommend them to anyone who asks.

reviews.author: Rob Mouat
reviews.text: Katie in the office was pleasant and professional arranging the recovery. Luis (Owner) showed up early and knocked out the job quickly. Hopefully I won’t need a lot of towing but if I do, Elite Towing is my go-to .

reviews.author: Cimani Lumzy
reviews.text: I am very thankful for Nate he was so sweet and amazing helping me with my tire. I definitely recommend him for any service. Thank you again so much

reviews.author: Jack Nathan
reviews.text: CEASAR was excellent he arrived actually little sooner than I was expecting an went about his business professionally and efficiently. He was personable during our ride to the dealership.
